title: CampusGo / Overview
description: Business activity, service performance, and durable event delivery. Fresh telemetry describes reporting freshness, not application availability.

panels.title: Current accounts
panels.description: Current durable account rows. Suspension state does not measure recent activity or distinct active users.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (max by (service_name,state) (campusgo_user_accounts{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}) < 45) and on(service_name) (max by (service_name) (campusgo_user_snapshot_available{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}) == 1) and on(service_name) (((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_user_snapshot_last_success_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"})) and on(service_name) (max by (service_name) (campusgo_user_snapshot_last_success_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name="user-service"}) > 0)) <= 90))

panels.title: Authentication responses by operation & outcome
panels.description: Final HTTP response classes: success=2xx, rejected=4xx, error=5xx. They do not identify the rejection's root cause.

panels.title: HTTP request rate by service
panels.description: Completed application HTTP requests; public/private health routes excluded. Connect null values: Threshold, 5 minutes; this affects line rendering only.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name) (rate(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name=~"(user|credit|order|supplier)-service",http_route!~"/(public|private)/health"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name=~"(user|credit|order|supplier)-service"}) < 45))

panels.title: HTTP p95 by service
panels.description: Histogram percentile estimates over the current rate window. Connect null values is set to Threshold, 5 minutes (custom.spanNulls=300000ms). Short gaps between observed points are connected visually; no samples are held or invented, and longer gaps remain disconnected. See the rolling selected-range table for persistent request summaries.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (service_name,le) (rate(campusgo_http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name=~"(user|credit|order|supplier)-service",http_route!~"/(public|private)/health"}[$__rate_interval])))) and on(service_name) ((time() - max by (service_name) (campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_namespace="campusgo",deployment_environment_name="${environment}",service_name=~"(user|credit|order|supplier)-service"}) < 45))
